For security reasons, nodes of this type cannot connect via Xray-core versions 26.2.6 or higher. If this is a self-built node, please enable TLS or other secure encryption, or pin the certificate using pinSHA256. If this is an airport/provider node, please contact your service provider for a technical upgrade. If the provider refuses to cooperate, it is recommended to switch to a service provider that prioritizes user security.
